title: Sphere
description: A psychologist (Dustin Hoffman), a biochemist (Sharon Stone), a mathematician (Samuel L. Jackson) and others investigate a large golden sphere deep in the ocean.

title: Moving
description: A yuppie (Richard Pryor) loses his job in New Jersey and moves his wife (Beverly Todd) and family to Boise, Idaho.

title: Addicted to Love
description: A man (Matthew Broderick) and a woman (Meg Ryan) meet by chance, then collaborate to spy on their exes, who are live-in lovers.

title: Vision Quest
description: A teenage wrestler (Matthew Modine) has trouble focusing on his training regimen when a worldly drifter (Linda Fiorentino) takes up temporary residence at his home.

title: Surf Ninjas
description: Two California surfers (Ernie Reyes Jr., Nicolas Cowan) try to overthrow a dictator as long-lost princes of a place called Patu San.

title: Preacher's Kid
description: A smooth-talking singer convinces a young woman (LeToya Luckett) to leave the security of her family, friends and church to join a traveling gospel show.

title: Forget Paris
description: Friends at a restaurant recall the romance of a yuppie couple (Billy Crystal, Debra Winger) who met in Paris four years before.

title: Beautiful Creatures
description: Teens (Alden Ehrenreich, Alice Englert) in a backwater Southern town encounter a history of family secrets and a curse that looms for one as she approaches her 16th birthday.

title: After the Sunset
description: An FBI agent (Woody Harrelson) thinks a master thief (Pierce Brosnan) and his girlfriend (Salma Hayek) will try to steal a valuable diamond from a cruise ship.

title: Matchstick Men
description: After meeting his daughter (Alison Lohman) for the first time, a con man (Nicolas Cage) and his partner (Sam Rockwell) try to swindle a boorish businessman.

title: The Hudsucker Proxy
description: A scheming executive promotes a mailroom worker to company president in the 1950s Manhattan.

title: Honeymoon in Vegas
description: A Las Vegas gambler (James Caan) wins a Hawaii fling with a private eye's (Nicolas Cage) bride (Sarah Jessica Parker) during a convention of Elvis impersonators.

title: Conspiracy Theory
description: An obsessive New York cabby (Mel Gibson), in love with a government worker (Julia Roberts), learns that one of his suspicions is justified.

title: Undisputed III: Redemption
description: Uri Boyka is an inmate trapped in the toughest prison in the world. He is ready to make his comeback in a lethal boxing competition for a shot at freedom.

title: Wildcats
description: A famous coach's daughter (Goldie Hawn) coaches boys football at a city high school patrolled by dogs.

title: City Hall
description: The New York mayor (Al Pacino) and his idealistic deputy (John Cusack) cope with scandal generated by a policeman's accidental shooting of a black boy.

title: Fathers' Day
description: Two Californians (Robin Williams, Billy Crystal) seek a former girlfriend's missing son, each believing he is the father of the boy.

title: Greystoke: The Legend of Tarzan, Lord of the Apes
description: A Belgian captain brings the ape-raised son (Christopher Lambert) of shipwrecked aristocrats home to his estate, his grandfather (Ralph Richardson) and Jane (Andie MacDowell) in Edwardian England.

title: The Golden Compass
description: In a parallel universe, young Lyra Belacqua journeys to the far North to save her best friend and other kidnapped children from terrible experiments by a mysterious organization.

title: Twilight Zone: The Movie
description: Four tales include a bigot (Vic Morrow), oldsters who find youth in playing kick the can, a misunderstood boy, and a terrified man (John Lithgow) on a plane.

title: Rumor Has It ...
description: A woman (Jennifer Aniston) sets out to find the truth after learning that the movie "The Graduate" may have been based on her family.

title: Her Alibi
description: A mystery writer (Tom Selleck) provides an alibi and a bedroom for a Romanian beauty (Paulina Porizkova) suspected of murder.

title: Sweet November
description: A workaholic executive (Keanu Reeves) and an unconventional woman (Charlize Theron) agree to a personal relationship for a trial period of one month.

title: Pleasantville
description: A shy suburban teen and his sister are transported into the black-and-white world of a 1950s TV sitcom.

title: No Reservations
description: A career-centered chef (Catherine Zeta-Jones) faces important changes in her life when she becomes her young niece's guardian and crosses forks with a brash employee in her kitchen.

title: The Man With Two Brains
description: A brain surgeon (Steve Martin) finds true love with a mass of cranial nerve tissue he wishes were his wife's (Kathleen Turner).

title: Collateral Damage
description: A Los Angeles firefighter (Arnold Schwarzenegger) travels to Colombia to find the terrorist who killed his wife and son.

title: This Boy's Life
description: A hip 1950s teen (Leonardo DiCaprio) butts heads with his mother's (Ellen Barkin) rude second husband (Robert De Niro).

title: Transcendence
description: A scientific genius's (Johnny Depp) controversial attempts to create a sentient machine take an unforeseen turn after he is mortally wounded during an attack by anti-technology radicals.

title: Where the Wild Things Are
description: Sent to bed without supper, a mischievous boy enters a land that grows out of his imagination and becomes king of the fantastic creatures who live there.

title: Curly Sue
description: A con man (James Belushi) targets a corporate lawyer (Kelly Lynch) and steals her heart with his adorable adopted daughter (Alisan Porter).

title: I Am Sam
description: A man (Sean Penn) with the mental capacity of a child hires a lawyer (Michelle Pfeiffer) to regain custody of his daughter.

title: Men Don't Leave
description: An indebted widow (Jessica Lange) sells the family home and starts over with her two sons (Chris O'Donnell, Charlie Korsmo) in Baltimore.

title: Ghosts of Mississippi
description: A Mississippi prosecutor (Alec Baldwin) and the widow (Whoopi Goldberg) of Medgar Evers crusade to retry a white racist (James Woods) for the 1963 murder of the NAACP leader.

title: Arthur
description: An irresponsible playboy (Russell Brand) must choose between an arranged marriage that will ensure his future wealth or following his heart with a woman (Greta Gerwig) he truly loves.

title: Caddyshack II
description: The snobby president (Robert Stack) of a country club tees off with a self-made man (Jackie Mason) whose daughter wants to join.

title: Private Benjamin
description: A pampered Jewish widow (Goldie Hawn) is tricked into joining the Army and unexpectedly finds a new sense of purpose and self-worth.

title: City by the Sea
description: A New York homicide detective (Robert De Niro) searches for his son (James Franco), the prime suspect in the murder of a drug dealer.

title: The Corruptor
description: An NYPD recruit (Mark Wahlberg) and his superior (Chow Yun-Fat) work to dampen the war between Triads and Dragons in Chinatown.

title: Mr. Wonderful
description: If a man (Matt Dillon) finds his ex-wife (Annabella Sciorra) a husband, he can then put her alimony toward his bowling-alley dream.

title: With Honors
description: The sole copy of a 100-page thesis falls into the hands of a homeless man (Joe Pesci) who uses it to blackmail a Harvard student (Brendan Fraser).
